<!-- WHY EDUCATION                                   -->
<!-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════ -->

      <h2 style="font-family: Playfair Display, serif; font-size: clamp(1.8rem, 3.2vw, 2.35rem); font-weight: 600; color: #0B1F3B; margin: 0 0 0.9rem; line-height: 1.2;">Education Makes the Difference</h2>
      <div style="width: 60px; height: 3px; background: #D4A017; margin-bottom: 1.6rem;"></div>
      <p style="font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 1.02rem; color: #5A5955; line-height: 1.8; margin: 0 0 1.1rem;">We believe education makes a difference in a person's life — especially Christian education. In a nation as young as South Sudan, a school is more than a building: it is a promise to the next generation that their future will be larger than their past.</p>
      <p style="font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 1.02rem; color: #5A5955; line-height: 1.8; margin: 0 0 1.1rem;">Our school will serve families who need a good Christian education for their children — grounding students in academic excellence and biblical truth at the same time, so that what is learned in the classroom takes root in character.</p>
      <p style="font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 1.02rem; color: #5A5955; line-height: 1.8; margin: 0;">All work is conducted in partnership with local churches, community leaders, and organizations — the people who know their communities best and will carry this school forward for decades.</p>
    </div>
    <div>

      <p style="font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 0.78rem; color: #8A8985; margin: 0.8rem 0 0; text-align: center;">From our earlier work: a classroom in the Biong community, where Y.E.T. Compassion supported schooling before the war.</p>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

          <p style="font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 0.9rem; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.65); line-height: 1.65; margin: 0;">Secure the site in Juba, lay the foundation, and raise the first classrooms so teaching can begin as early as possible.</p>
